About AJ's Tree Service

Family Owned & Built on Trust

We are a family owned business that has been around since 2003. We were located in Mason, Ohio and recently relocated to New Carlisle, Ohio.

We not only do tree and landscape work, but we also do remodels, fence and pool installs. We do it all!

🇺🇸 🇲🇽 English & Spanish spoken

  • Free and fast estimates — no waiting, no hidden fees

Certified & Trusted

ISA Certified Arborist

Anthony Vazquez holds an active ISA Certified Arborist® credential — the gold standard in professional tree care. This certification means your trees receive expert, science-based care from someone who has proven their knowledge and commitment to the industry.

The ISA Certified Arborist® program is accredited by ANAB (ANSI/ISO 17024) and recognized worldwide as the benchmark of excellence in arboriculture.
